_approach: The dembow cell hollowed out for a breakdown: the snare rides the dembow rhythm of ukfunky_dembow_lean_01 at ghost velocity with no backbeat clap at all, mid-tom jabs answer sparsely, and a soft rim/shaker bed keeps the pulse until the floor returns tresillo-style. Ref: the dembow-lean approach (Donae'o "Party Hard", Ill Blu), Wikipedia's UK funky entry on the dembow rhythm cell. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
